title: TriZOD — Re-referenced BMRB chemical-shift dataset for protein disorder
description: Per-residue protein-disorder labels derived from BMRB NMR backbone chemical shifts. Observed shifts are re-referenced (LACS + POTENCI/AIC) and scored against POTENCI random-coil predictions to give CheZOD-style per-residue Z-scores and the continuous TriZOD G-score (0-1, higher = more disordered), the label. The dataset is ONE Parquet file (trizod_dataset.parquet): one row per scored protein chain, with per-residue G-score, Z-score, shift-count (k) and boolean mask lists aligned 1:1 to the sequence, plus sample conditions, rule flags, re-referencing offsets, UniProt/PDB cross-references and citation provenance. Four nested stringency tiers (unfiltered, tolerant, moderate, strict) and redundancy-reduced training representatives are selected through the split and train_tier columns. Held-out test sets: TriZOD-test v1.0 (drawn from the strict tier; from this release on it only shrinks, retired chains stay leakage targets) and CheZOD117. Training sets are separated from both at 30 % identity over 80 % of either chain, searched in both directions with a 27-bit floor, and share no exact substring of 20 or more residues with a test chain. Evaluation cuts on G (metadata, not label columns): ordered G < 0.15, disordered G >= 0.35, confidently disordered G >= 0.70. Also included: the chemical-shift table (trizod_shifts.parquet), a UdonPred v2 JSONL view, a SETH/ODiNPred-style FASTA, the test-set crosswalk across earlier TriZOD test sets, a column dictionary, a datasheet, a changelog and a MANIFEST with SHA-256 checksums. Counts and changes since v0.3.0 are in README.md and CHANGELOG.md.
